messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — HelioForge reserved pool is scheduled for go-live next Tue. We need to finalize quota, autoscale, and the load-test window by EOD today.

sam_ops: ack. current ask from billing is 8 gpus reserved (p4d-equivalent). they want a burst config too.

priya_se: FYI HelioForge will route 80% of production traffic to dedicated once we flip. they want <150ms p95 if possible.

maria_cs: Goal is 120ms p95. we can relax to 200ms during first 24h. need autoscale policy and priming plan.

 tim_infra: proposed autoscale: min_replicas=2, steady_replicas=4, max_replicas=12, burst_capacity=4. scale-up on 75% GPU util over 30s, scale-down after 5m idle.

devon_reliability: +1. also recommend KV cache prefill for top 50 prefixes to avoid cold-start token spikes. we can push prefix list to s3 before handoff.

sam_ops: sounds good. what's the warmup token budget? HelioForge asked about cost impact.

priya_se: plan: run a priming job of 20M tokens over 2 hours across pool; that should populate caches and checkpoint kernels. budget estimate ~ $1.8k on reserved pricing.

maria_cs: add that to the customer runbook and to the invoice estimate. can someone paste the load test command?

sam_ops: here is the load generator snippet we'll run in k8s:```bash
docker run --rm helio-loadgen:stable \\n  --endpoint https://dedicated.helio.redwood/api/generate \\n  --concurrency 40 \\n  --rate 30 \\n  --duration 2h \
  --prompt-file /data/top_prompts.json
```

devon_reliability: test phases: (1) smoke 5m at 10rps, (2) burst replay 10m at peak profile, (3) soak 2h at expected 30rps. monitor p95, 429s, and token cost.

maria_cs: owner assignments: sam_ops -> execute load tests and post logs; tim_infra -> ensure autoscale hooks + runbook; devon_reliability -> monitoring alerts and fallback policy; priya_se -> customer comms and rollback plan.

sam_ops: noted. i'll run smoke in staging at 1600 PST, then prod-dryrun at 1800 if all green.

priya_se: i'll send an enablement note to HelioForge with the timeline, rollback steps, and contact roster.

maria_cs: one risk: HelioForge's renewal discussion is next month. if we miss SLA in first week we could escalate. aim to have canary & A/B fallback to hosted model for first 48h.

devon_reliability: implement automatic fallback: if p95>300ms for >10m or error rate >2% trigger fallback to hosted variant with same model family. we already have the playbook.

sam_ops: deploy-bot: start loadgen smoke now.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] loadgen job submitted to cluster helio-loadgen-prod-3, job id=lg-20240314-998.

maria_cs: please paste smoke results when ready.

sam_ops: smoke done: 0 errors, p95=110ms, 429=0, avg cost estimate inline. moving to prod-dryrun at 1800.

priya_se: i'll loop in customer success manager and account exec on results. also capturing feedback form link for HelioForge SREs to report any anomalies post flip: https://forms.redwood/helioforge-go-live-feedback

maria_cs: perfect. after prod-dryrun we'll confirm final quota numbers and schedule the actual flip. thanks team :raised_hands:
